evidenceNotes: The uploaded Stage 3 starter was treated as orientation and independently checked against live GitHub before implementation.
The predecessor handoff was stale only because its transition PR #128 had subsequently merged; live source confirmed PR #128 contains no Stage 3 runtime implementation.
Existing Save Library identity already supplies stable save_* and profile_* identifiers, so Stage 3 can bind manager slots without inventing a new profile authority.

Existing remote contract defines private device, rivalry and invite paths but Spark production Rules still deny downstream writes, so a genuinely new Stage 3 Rules source change will be required before production pairing can work.

Initial Stage 3 pairing will keep the capability private and avoid server infrastructure by using the same 256-bit opaque identifier as the initial rivalryId and inviteId, enabling deterministic Firestore getAfter() validation without duplicating the secret into document data.

Device identity will live in IndexedDB rather than localStorage and will not fingerprint hardware; failure to obtain it disables only optional remote Stage 3 operations while local career saves remain authoritative.
